newsitem.title: USA: Ukraine sees harvest 27.5 Mln tonnes-US attache.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine sees harvest 27.5 Mln tonnes-US attache.

text.p: Ukraine's deputy prime minister has predicted the grain harvest will not exceed 27.5 million tonnes, the U.S. attache in Kiev said in a report released Thursday.
If so, it would be a much smaller crop was forecast earlier and would mean "substantially less" grain for export than the government desires, the attache wrote.
Industry sources said rules on state procurement of grain could slow down deliveries and jeopardize export contracts for four million tonnes of wheat worth $400 million.

"The major foreign buyers that might be affected...include Lithuania, the Netherlands, Switzerland and Belarus," the attache said. "Some of the first-time buyers like Iran, Turkey and China might also be affected by Ukraine's grain harvest and delivery problems."
